DamageTracker::new: Creates a tracker that has seen no frames yet.
DamageTracker::reset: Forgets the last frame so the next damage report is a full redraw.
FontSpec: The font settings that shape a text node's lines, shared by painting and measuring.
FontSpec.weight: The font weight, such as 400 for regular.
FontSpec.options: Extra text options such as wrapping and line limits.
FrameRenderer: Wraps the vello renderer together with the resources it needs on every render call.
FrameRenderer::new: Creates a renderer for the given device and render target configuration.
FrameRenderer::render_into: Renders a scene, clearing only the given rects and keeping the rest of the target.
FrameRenderer::render_over: Renders a scene on top of the target's existing pixels without clearing anything.
FrameRenderer::resources_mut: Gives access to the renderer's resources, which glyph drawing needs.
FrameRenderer::run_shader_passes: Runs this frame's shader passes and offscreen effect renders in dependency order.
FrameRenderer::skip_shader_passes: Marks a frame that draws nothing, so no shader pass ran.
FrameRenderer::sync_image_textures: Uploads GPU textures for every image node so they are ready before the next render.
GeometryCache: Caches tessellated rounded-rect paths across frames so they rebuild only on change.
GeometryCache::evict_stale: Drops cached paths belonging to nodes that no longer exist in the tree.
GeometryCache::rounded_rect_border: Returns the cached border path for a uniform rounded rect, inset by half the stroke.
GeometryCache::rounded_rect_border_per_c: Returns the cached border path for a rounded rect with a separate radius per corner.
GeometryCache::rounded_rect_fill: Returns the cached fill path for a uniform rounded rect, rebuilt only on change.
GeometryCache::rounded_rect_fill_per_cor: Returns the cached fill path for a rounded rect with a separate radius per corner.
NoFontFacesFound: The error returned when font bytes contain no parseable font face.
NoFontFacesFound.byte_len: The length in bytes of the data that was rejected.
TextPlacement: Where and how wide to draw one text node.
TextPlacement.x: The left edge of the text, in the node's local coordinates.
TextPlacement.y: The top edge of the text, in the node's local coordinates.
TextPlacement.color: The color the text is drawn in.
TextRenderer: Holds the font and text layout state that is kept between frames.
TextRenderer::draw: Shapes and wraps a text node's content and draws its glyphs into the scene.
TextRenderer::draw_field: Draws an editable text field, including its selection and optionally its caret.
TextRenderer::draw_terminal: Draws a terminal's cell grid with backgrounds, glyphs and optionally the cursor.
TextRenderer::evict_stale_layouts: Drops cached text layouts belonging to nodes that no longer exist in the tree.
TextRenderer::hit_test_position: Returns the character index in a text field that a local point falls on.
TextRenderer::measure: Returns the width and height the content takes when laid out with the given font.
TextRenderer::monospace_cell_size: Returns the width and height of one monospace cell at the given font and size.
TextRenderer::new: Creates a text renderer with the bundled fonts loaded.
TextRenderer::terminal_hit_cell: Returns the terminal column and row that a local point falls on.
WindowRenderer: Owns a window's renderer, caches and kept frame.
WindowRenderer::draw: Draws the frame that the damage report calls for and presents it to the surface.
WindowRenderer::draw_damage_overlay: Tints the areas that were just redrawn so damage can be seen while debugging.
WindowRenderer::new: Creates a renderer for a surface of the given size and format.
WindowRenderer::prepare: Uploads images, drops stale caches and returns what changed since the last frame.
Damage: What needs redrawing since the last frame.
Damage::None: Nothing changed, so the frame can be skipped.
Damage::Full: The whole window must be redrawn.
Damage::Rects: Only these window-pixel rectangles must be redrawn.
GpuReport: Something the GPU reported about its own health.
GpuReport::Lost: The device was lost, through a driver fault or a hang.
GpuReport::Error: The device reported an error and the draw that caused it is skipped.
GpuReport::Stalled: A submitted frame has not completed after the given number of seconds.
build_rect_scene: Builds a scene with one centered rounded rectangle in the given color and opacity.
build_shadow_scene: Builds a scene with a blurred rounded-rect shadow in the given color.
build_tree_scene: Paints the whole node tree from the root into a scene.
build_tree_scene_in: Paints only what falls inside the given rects, for a partial redraw.
build_tree_scene_shaded: Paints the tree, drawing nodes that have a shader from that shader's texture.
register_font: Registers font file bytes for all text renderers and returns the family names found.
with_opacity: Returns the color with its alpha multiplied by the given opacity.
INITIAL_COLOR: The purple used as the starting fill color of the demo scene.
MAX_IMAGE_DIMENSION: The largest image side, in pixels, that is uploaded to the GPU.
MAX_RECTS: The most damage rects kept before the closest pairs are merged.
MONOSPACE_FONT_FAMILY: The family name of the bundled monospace font.
EventLoopWaker: A thread-safe handle that background code uses to wake or steer the event loop.
EventLoopWaker::close_window: Asks the loop to close a window as if the user had, letting the app veto it.
EventLoopWaker::report_size: Asks the loop to report a window's current size as a resize event on its next turn.
EventLoopWaker::wake: Requests a redraw of every open window, doing nothing if the loop has exited.
IdleHooks: Callbacks run around the loop's wait so the host can release a lock while idle.
IdleHooks.release: Called just before the loop goes to wait, to release the host's lock.
IdleHooks.reacquire: Called right after the loop wakes, to take the host's lock back.
WindowConfig: The title, size, frame limit and creation options for a window.
WindowConfig.title: The window title.
WindowConfig.width: The initial inner width in pixels.
WindowConfig.height: The initial inner height in pixels.
WindowConfig.max_frames: Closes the window after this many redraws, which keeps demos and tests self-ending.
WindowOpener: A handle for asking the loop to open new windows, valid only inside the setup callback.
WindowOpener::open_window: Asks the event loop to open a new window.
WindowOptions.icon: The window icon as straight-alpha RGBA8 bytes with width and height.
WindowRequest: A request to open one window, tagged with a token the app can match later.
WindowRequest.config: The configuration for the window to open.
WindowRequest.token: A caller-chosen number passed back when the window is created.
WindowLifecycle: A change in a window's life that the loop reports to the app.
WindowLifecycle::CloseRequested: The user asked to close the window, and the app may keep it open.
double_click_time: Returns the longest gap between two presses that still counts as a double-click.
platform_name: Returns the windowing system the window runs on, such as wayland, x11, windows or macos.
run_windowed: Runs an event loop for a single window that calls a per-frame callback.
run_windowed_multi: Runs an event loop that manages any number of windows through callbacks.
run_windowed_multi_with: Runs the multi-window loop with optional hooks around its idle wait.
